text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun got injured during training,
so I hurriedly brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aww, ouchie!
I don't think I can train like this~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that sounds nice too, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "If Trainer-chan nurses me, maybe I'll get waaaay better♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyaa☆ Yay, yeeey~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then,
first let's check your temperature with my forehead~...
choice_data_list: A fever? But it's an injury?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! All that racing excitement will make the pain go
zoooom, fly away—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oof!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: H-Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Honestly, it might hurt... quite a bit.

I frantically took care of Mayano Top Gun,
who had pushed herself way too hard,
and managed to get her to rest peacefully...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! No it's not!
This is how 'adults' act spoiled~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's so weird~ The book said this was a surefire hit☆...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see! It's because I don't have a fever!
If I get a fever, then just like the book says――

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... okaaay.

Mayano Top Gun looked dissatisfied,
but I managed to get her to rest quietly...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be
this isn't to Trainer-chan's liking?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, Trainer-chan!
What should Maya do to make your heart skip a beat~?
choice_data_list: Nothing makes me happier than seeing you healthy and energetic.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Cheer me up...? Does Maya just being happy make you happy too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehehehe... ehehehehehe~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Maya will get plenty of rest
and recharge all her energy~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then!
Let's train together again, okay? ☆

True to her word, Mayano Top Gun got plenty of rest...
and resumed training in high spirits!
